Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist said about it: Through an affordable sharing model, farmers rent storage space for as little as US$ 0.10-0.50 per crate per day from the Preserving Harvests: Fresh Solutions to Food Loss in Kenya (E72), and that daily fee funds the attendant, paper tags, twice-daily thermometer checks and hose cleaning with no electronic control from my field.
Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist said about it: I take up the guidance in 48V Lithium Battery Maintenance Guide: How To Extend Your Solar Battery Lifespan And Improve Performance (E80) that you put on the board, which gives 10 to 15 years with monthly wipe and terminal checks, which means my attendant can do it with no specialist, funded through farmers renting space for as little as US$ 0.10 to 0.50 per crate per day from Preserving Harvests: Fresh Solutions to Food Loss in Kenya (E72) for tags, twice-daily thermometer checks and hose cleaning.
Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist said about it: Reusing the total produce mass estimate (E49) for 1000 kg as 50 crates from the crates for 1 tonne check (E77) at 20 kg each within single-person lift guidance from the manual handling sources, staged as 12.5 crates per day from the daily crates for 250 kg staged intake (E78) under the staged rule from the revised steady-load simulation (E28), moved one 600 by 400 mm crate at a time through the 900 mm single-leaf door from the Coolroom Buying Guide: Walk-In Refrigeration for Kitchens (E71) onto two rack rows with 25 mm gaps per ventilation guidance from the Cold Storage of Agricultural Products source, with First-In-First-Out (FIFO, oldest produce sold first) paper tags plus twice-daily wall thermometer checks and a door log funded by the pay-per-crate model from The Solution – ColdHubs (E43) and affordability precedent from Preserving Harvests: Fresh Solutions to Food Loss in Kenya (E72).
